messages:
Elena Morales: Starting a tiny PR to clarify quota tier names and add a short example for client-side routing based on `X-Quota-Tier`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521
Rajat Singh: Good. Add an explicit mapping table for legacy tier values coming from older telemetry proxies. Customers hit this frequently.
Elena Morales: Draft mapping: legacy `bronze` -> `starter`, `silver` -> `scale-lite`, `gold` -> `scale`. Will include code to normalize header values.
Maya Brooks: For the dashboard rename, update the panel caption to "Token consumption (formerly Total usage)" and include alt text for screenshots. I uploaded new PNGs to assets/pr-521.
Rajat Singh: SDK snippet request: minimal TypeScript showing how to fallback to a lower-cost model when tier == "starter". Keep it ~5 lines.
Elena Morales: Snippet:
```ts
const tier = resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Tier') || 'unknown';
if (tier === 'starter') {
  routeTo('gpt-small-cheap');
}
```
DocsBot: PR 521 opened by Elena Morales  CI: docs-build (staging) queued  Preview: https://deploy-preview-521--docs.redwood.ai
Maya Brooks: QA checklist: update links, verify header names across Dedicated versions, l10n key for new panel label, and add a one-line troubleshooting note about mismatched tiers.
Elena Morales: Thanks — aiming to merge Thu. I'll tag i18n and eng-runtime for a quick pass.
